reasoning: This repository is a container image build configuration project. It contains Dockerfiles, Makefiles, build-arg configs, and manifests for building Jupyter notebook workbench images, Code-Server workbench images, Elyra runtime images, and base images for the OpenDataHub/RHOAI ecosystem. It does not implement an operator (no controller/reconciler logic), is not a library (no importable packages), and is not a service (no running server process). Its primary purpose is defining the build configuration and image layering for containerized data science workbench environments, with supporting CI, test, and lock-file tooling. The directory structure (jupyter/, codeserver/, runtimes/, base-images/, manifests/) organizes multi-stage Dockerfile definitions and their build parameters across ODH and RHOAI product variants.
